backbone: A small complementing 2NFA yields an order-reversing image of a path-diagram monoid onto all relations; induction on h with conjugate amplification gives an exponential recurrence.
quote: We induct on $h$, simultaneously over all the data in the statement, including $m$, $e$, $S$, and $\phi$.

backbone: Explicit uniform algorithm: finite tensor savings amplified and transferred to Fourier matrices via Toeplitz/convolution factorizations, CRT working lengths, chirp convolution and a uniform radix printer.
quote: We give a deterministic algorithm that computes the discrete Fourier transform at every length n in $`O(n(\log n)^{1-10^{-13}})`$ operations.

backbone: Pair-resampling projections satisfy the operator inequality H^2 >= H via a three-row variance inequality; kernel is constants, and comparison with single switches yields the spectral gap and mixing time.
quote: The central estimate is $H^2\succeq H$, where $\succeq$ denotes the order of quadratic forms. Once the kernel of $H$ is shown to consist of constants, comparison with individual switches gives the stated gap and mixing time.

backbone: Recursively constructed nested Boolean predicates on labelled tournaments; sensitivity recurrences bound s, disjoint blocks at zero give bs, and OR-balancing plus composition amplify to a power separation.
quote: We recursively construct nested families of Boolean predicates: their accepting sets decrease as the predicate index increases.

backbone: Compressed reduction from arc-consistency (encoding a one-tape computation) to WL equivalence of diameter-two graphs; a fast WL decider would decide a padded diagonal language too fast.
quote: such that Duplicator wins the $K$-pair bijective game on $G^0,G^1$ if and only if the instance has individual-edge arc consistency.

backbone: Explicit expressions: monoid computations as affine episode updates recovered by two split constructions with clocks and markers; finite parameters chosen via probabilistic/LLL existence; height counted.
quote: We prove the theorem by a complete construction over the given alphabet.

backbone: Rank measure from differentiation and multiplication: homogeneous depth-five circuits of size S have small measure, trace-moment computation shows IMM has large measure, compare; block expansion gives upper bound.
quote: Let $K$ be a field, and let $g\in K[V,U]$ be a homogeneous degree-$n$ polynomial computed by a syntactically homogeneous $\Sigma\Pi\Sigma\Pi\Sigma$ circuit of size $S$. Then \[ R(g)\le 2S^2D\exp(C\sqrt n)\,n^{-\sqrt n/100}. \]

backbone: Explicit quasilinear reduction: sparse End-of-Line macrograph encoded by outer group codes and certified programs, composed with a robust inner algebraic gadget; a decoder recovers a solution from near-satisfying assignments.
quote: a deterministic polynomial-time reduction that transforms an End-of-Line instance of binary length N into a generalized circuit of total binary length $`N(\log N)^{O(1)}`$.

backbone: Explicit space-efficient simulator: block visits and epoch transcripts form factored word recurrences evaluated by a Cook-Mertz style shared-register algebraic evaluator, recursively along weighted dependency paths.
quote: We show that a fixed deterministic Turing machine with one writable tape and head can be simulated in $`O(T^{2/5}\mathop{\mathrm{polylog}}\nolimits (T+2))`$ work-space bits when a binary time cap T ≥ 2 is supplied.

backbone: Explicit randomized algorithm: split on deficiency; else estimate a random-prime modular checksum via filtered Fourier frequencies and subtract all extracted aliases; filtering moments certified by interval arithmetic.
quote: We estimate the modular sum and subtract the phases of a complete list of aliases.

backbone: Explicit sampler: recursively nested noisy conditional means approximate smoothed Picard flows with dimension-free tensor derivative bounds; a contracting noised chain removes noise; Krylov argument gives log lower bound.

backbone: Backward argument: split the stream into blocks; an exact Gaussian projection bound limits how much localized success mass each block of memory-bounded computation can gain; iterate the coefficient recurrence.
quote: For \(T>0\), partition the stream into \(m=\lceil T/p\rceil\) consecutive blocks, each of length at most \(p=k_0\).

backbone: Reduce an EA sentence to two existential tests with short algebraic root labels; evaluate them via controlled polynomial families, residue-trace determinants and CRT sign recovery inside fixed counting-hierarchy levels.
quote: More generally, we show that the truth of existential--universal sentences over the reals can be decided in a fixed level of the counting hierarchy, even when the integer polynomials are given by arithmetic circuits.

backbone: Explicit deterministic algorithm: reduce to splitting; even degrees via primary-subgroup logs, odd degrees via divisor-class divisions and norm equations on a cyclic cover; auxiliary primes via cited zero-free theorem.
quote: We give a uniform deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for complete factorization over prime fields.

backbone: Finite templates reduce returns to matching systems; absolute isolated-zero finiteness is proved by contradiction along escaping sequences via asymptotic-expansion separation; a counting principle gives the uniform bound.
quote: Suppose it has a sequence of distinct isolated total solutions.

backbone: Iterative smooth construction: successive stages perturb the diffeomorphism and observable so Laurent polynomials in the Koopman operator approximate any target; smooth limit gives a cyclic orthonormal basis.

backbone: Assume a least failing order; obtain a zero-entropy finite-alphabet witness; build saturated ordered arrays whose operator square yields abelian unitary labels; entropy cancellation contradicts the correlation.
quote: Suppose an invertible mixing transformation fails to be mixing of every order. There then exist an integer $k\geq3$, a finite alphabet $\mathcal A$, a shift-invariant probability measure $\mu_X$ on $X=\mathcal A^{\Z}$

backbone: Assume zero exponent for arbitrarily large parameters; cancellation scarcity and fast-bridge estimates control rescaled limits of growth-shortfall arrays; a capped-deficit telescoping balance gives a contradiction.
quote: Passing to the limit in that balance is itself a proof obligation.

backbone: Continuous phase foliation gives periodic rational leaves, Newton schemes upgrade to analytic boundary and jointly analytic caustic collar; collar rigidity (meromorphic continuation, excluding walls by contradiction) forces ellipse.
quote: Here we establish the additional dynamical and geometric steps needed to apply them to a merely continuous phase foliation. In particular, we construct the physical collar before invoking the companion's ellipse theorem.

backbone: Upper bound by regrouping into distinct-map alphabet; lower bound by contradiction: a dimension deficit yields pair mass in scale bands and disjoint entropy-gain windows contradicting the entropy rate.
quote: We prove the upper bound before turning to the contradiction argument.

backbone: Construct a finite minimum of affine functions in log coordinates (inductively on dimension) whose plateau is a compact convex set; graph-cut flux signs make the minimum increase outside it.
quote: The proof will use a finite minimum of affine functions on the positive orthant. Its essential property is that an active slope approximates the exponent vector of the point where it is active.

backbone: Angular Fourier-mode energy estimates show a bounded eigenfunction on the flat double is transversally rigid, hence a plane wave; holonomy at the irrational angle forces it to be constant.
quote: Expand a bounded eigenfunction on the double in angular Fourier modes.

backbone: Explicit C1 map: clock circle, squaring sphere and register spheres injecting predictive signals; every orbit converges to two zero-entropy sets, and homology is intertwined with z->z^2.
quote: We construct a map with a circular clock, a main sphere coordinate, and finitely many auxiliary sphere coordinates, called registers.

backbone: Smooth positive volume implies a past-future switching estimate with controlled volume; an explicit symbolic word system with orthogonality constraints violates it, so no conjugacy exists.
quote: We construct the opposing symbolic system from finite sets $\mathcal W_i$ of words of lengths $m_i$.

backbone: Both directions: algebraic unit clusters imply singularity; conversely singular concentration gives close word pairs, completed by a realization lemma to irreducible height-one polynomials with roots just above lambda.
quote: The main step behind the criterion is a realization lemma. Concentration of the measure produces many pairs of finite bit words with nearby sums and different first bits.

backbone: If pointwise convergence fails, measurable selectors give a joining law on outputs; minimal-correlation saturated extensions, tensor packing and a square argument force a nonvanishing pairing, contradicting higher-order mixing.
quote: If Theorem~\ref{thm:main} fails, there are real functions $f_i\in L^\infty(\mu)$ with $\|f_i\|_\infty\le1$ and $\int f_i\,\dd\mu=0$

backbone: Encode a non-periodic Sudoku line rule as simultaneous tiling equations over Z^2 times a cyclic group, exhibit a common solution, stack into one tile and pass to Z^3 and R^3.
quote: We construct a finite translational tile in $\Z^3$ that admits tilings but no fully periodic tiling.

backbone: Explicit set of rank-one projectors; a putative 10-cover gives an admissible map RP^3 to a simplex; degree and simplicial-cycle arguments plus case analysis on ten labels yield a contradiction.
quote: A hypothetical cover by ten sets of strictly smaller diameter can be enlarged to an open cover.

backbone: Triangle-free hole relation from F2 tensor equations; entropy/moment supersaturation forces conflicts between units; container argument passes to a random finite sample whose complement has small clique minors.
quote: The distribution-to-graph argument combines information projection~\citep{csiszar1975}, independent-set fingerprints~\citep{kleitmanwinston1982,samotij2015}, and a capacitated cut~\citep{fordfulkerson1956}.

backbone: A proper 5-colouring transfers to a weak measurable colouring; rigidity and limiting continua give angular label constraints; label cycles of length 5, 4, 3 each yield contradictions.
quote: A simple cycle on five labels has length three, four, or five. Section~\ref{sec:angular} excludes each possibility.

backbone: Density-increment iteration on polynomial cells: a progression-free certified set yields a new certificate at threshold (1+eta)a; iteration terminates quasipolynomially, giving summable r_k(2^m)/2^m and hence Erdos.
quote: either the hypotheses are impossible or a root slice carries a new certificate at threshold $(1+\eta)a$.
